name: AxleHarbor
tagline: Fleet telematics engineered for the owner-operator who signs the checks.
positioning: AxleHarbor gives small fleets enterprise-grade GPS, engine diagnostics, and IFTA reporting in one console — priced per driver, not per truck.

hero.h1: Every truck accounted for. Every mile documented.
hero.sub: AxleHarbor consolidates live tracking, engine fault codes, driver hours, and fuel-tax filings into a single operations console built for fleets of 3 to 40 vehicles.

features.title: Real-Time Fleet Visibility
features.description: Track every vehicle on one map with 10-second location refresh, geofence alerts, and stop-history playback you can pull up during a customer dispute.

features.title: Engine Health Diagnostics
features.description: Read live OBD-II and J1939 fault codes, get flagged before a check-engine light becomes a roadside breakdown, and schedule service by odometer.

features.title: Automated IFTA Reporting
features.description: Mileage-by-jurisdiction is calculated continuously, so quarterly fuel-tax filings export in minutes instead of a weekend of spreadsheets.

features.title: Hours-of-Service Logging
features.description: ELD-compliant driver logs sync automatically, warning operators of impending violations before an officer ever asks for the record.

features.title: Fuel & Idle Control
features.description: Identify excessive idling, unauthorized fuel purchases, and fuel-card mismatches with weekly variance reports sent to your inbox.

features.title: Driver Safety Scoring
features.description: Score harsh braking, speeding, and cornering per driver, then export coachable reports that hold up in your insurance renewal review.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose a full Saturday every quarter reconciling IFTA miles. AxleHarbor exports the filing in under ten minutes, and it's matched every audit line so far.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Priebe

testimonials.quote: The engine fault alerts flagged a failing injector on unit 12 two days before it would have stranded a load. That single catch paid for our whole year.
testimonials.name: Marisol Tejada

testimonials.quote: Our insurance carrier dropped our premium after we showed them AxleHarbor's driver safety reports. It turned telematics from a cost into a bargaining chip.
testimonials.name: Grant Holloway

pricing.blurb: Core tracking and diagnostics for the small fleet just getting organized.
features: Email support within one business day
